summary.text: Leslie Chambers Mehta is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 73rd District, which covers part of Chesterfield County, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Mehta sits on the House committees on Courts of Justice and Transportation.

paragraphs.text: Leslie Chambers Mehta was born in New York, New York, according to the House profile.

The profile lists Mehta's education as North Carolina School of Science and Mathematics (diploma, 1995); University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill (B.A., English, 1999); Howard University School of Law (J.D., 2002).
The profile gives Mehta's occupation as attorney.
Mehta's listed memberships and affiliations include Leadership Metro Richmond; Board of Directors, International Rett Syndrome Foundation; Rare Disease Council for Gov. Youngkin.
